title: Admin adjusts stock with an audit trail

card.i_want: to adjust a SKU's stock with a mandatory reason
card.so_that: physical counts stay correct and every change is traceable

context: Admin may receive/count/write-off stock but must give a reason and may not reduce available below the currently reserved quantity; each change is audited with before/after.

given: a SKU with 10 available and 2 reserved
acceptance_criteria.when: the admin sets available to 12 with reason 'received from supplier'
then: an audit entry records actor, reason and before/after

given: a SKU with 5 available and 3 reserved
acceptance_criteria.when: the admin tries to set available to 2
then: the adjustment is rejected because it would drop below the reserved quantity
an audit event {event, actor, ts, sku, reason, before, after, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: stock adjustments carry no personal data

audit_events.justification: manual stock changes must be fully attributable

idempotency.justification: each manual adjustment is a distinct intentional entry, not a replayed event

reversibility.justification: a wrong adjustment is corrected by a new audited adjustment, not an in-place reversal

authn_authz.justification: only admin role may adjust stock
